decisions.reason: Archiving and reporting software has had its own web page for years and sits at the center of the firm's data-driven, web-based direction, and B was already dropped in its favor, so the investment and public commitment make withdrawal unlikely.

The manhole door with safety railing extends the established hardware line with its own web page, and safety equipment for municipal operators sells steadily, so management sees no reason to abandon it.

Control technology for water engineering machinery ties the firm's machinery to its automation and integrated-solutions strategy, so management would attribute any weak results to temporary causes and persist.

Flow measurement automation software is close to the core offer, fits the announced connected-infrastructure direction and was publicly launched with its own page, so the firm would keep investing in it despite limited visibility since 2019.
